summary: Tube Lake tower near Walford, Ontario; its cab was lost, and if the Wikipedia old Walford fire tower is this one, it still stands; no source describes visiting it.

facts.status_note: The cab is lost. Wikipedia says the old Walford fire tower still stands; that is matched to Victoria on place only.

evidence.supports: location given as Sables-Spanish Rivers, Ontario
index lists the Victoria tower at Tube Lake, Walford
the old Walford fire tower still stands north of the village on Tube Lake
evidence.quote: The old Walford fire tower still stands north of the village on Tube Lake.

evidence.supports: Walford is the westernmost community of the township, along Highway 17
evidence.quote: is the westernmost community of the township located along Highway 17

evidence.supports: cab was intact years ago but was later lost
evidence.quote: The cab on this tower was still intact years ago but more recently was lost to something or someone.

notes_for_editor: The Victoria tower and the Walford fire tower are matched on place only: the Canada Lookouts index gives 'Tube Lake Walford' for Victoria, and Wikipedia describes 'the old Walford fire tower' on Tube Lake, but no source names both. The story says the two appear to be the same structure. The cached Ontario LIO geojson lists a 'Victoria Fire Tower' (TOWER_IDENT SF-57, LOCATION_DESCR 'Vicoria Twp.') with no construction date and no page URL, so it is not cited. No build date, height, design, staffing or managing agency was found in any source read. The brief's status_note matches the Firelookout.ca record; the 'still stands' point rests on the Wikipedia sentence. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept as no source found.
